notes.text: The named grade is R. Meir, whose name appears in the immediately preceding passage. Sefaria’s Epistle names Yaakov ben Dosai. The printed PDF body reads Yaakov ben Dosa, but its textual note explicitly attests an Akiva ben Dosa variant and separately Yose ben Dosa. Exact Yuḥasin witness remains to check.
The reciprocal Heilprin article 2129 is headed Yaakov ben Dosai and points back to Akiva ben Dosa. The cross-link identifies the cited article and preserves the reading of each.
The chronology of the Epistle immediately names Meir. Its body and apparatus distinguish Yaakov and Akiva, while the precise Yuḥasin witness remains open.
Explicit internal pointer to Yaakov ben Dosa.
Exact Yuḥasin text and its relationship to the variant in the printed Epistle require edition collation.
